intent: Canonical element-type glyph shown beside a layer in the Layers panel and the element timeline.

autoLayoutAlign: end (counter-axis alignment; picks the glyph for horizontal/vertical frames, defaults to start)

tokens.note: size (default 16) and strokeWidth (default 1.5) are numeric props forwarded to the Lucide glyph — plain values, not tokens.

a11y.role: none rendered — a plain Lucide SVG glyph with no role, aria-label, or aria-hidden; presentational.
a11y.labeling: Carries no accessible name; the layer's own name in the row (Layers panel / element timeline) is the accessible label. Never let this icon be the sole conveyor of element type.
a11y.attributes: data-icon-semantic, data-layer-icon-type, data-auto-layout-mode, and data-auto-layout-align expose the resolved glyph and inputs for QA/tests, not for assistive tech.
